title: Tsofaffi da matasa
description: Ten short stories about old and young: a grandson's first Friday sermon in his grandfather's Katsina mosque, a Zaria grandmother who weaves her granddaughter's wedding cloth, an old hunter and his grandson chasing wild pigs near Bauchi, a Kano grandmother's first passport for a trip to London, a flood from the Tiga dam, a Sokoto praise singer and his namesake grandson, an old man in Kaduna robbed by phone fraudsters, a widow's iddah in Gombe, a young couple in Jos and a mother-in-law who blamed the wrong person, and a retired teacher in Maradi who regrets his cane.

lessons.title: Huɗubar farko ta Hayatuddeen
lessons.summary: In Katsina, the old imam Malam Sharifai can no longer stand long in the pulpit, so his grandson Hayatuddeen gives his first Friday sermon: his grandfather tells him to keep it short, to repeat the main point, and to be careful with fatwas from other countries; the worshippers answer his prayer with amin summa amin.
lessons.text:
Malam Sharifai shi ne limamin babban masallacin unguwarsu a Katsina tun shekara arba'in. Yanzu ya tsufa, ya kai shekara tamanin, kuma ƙafafunsa ba su da ƙarfi kamar a baya. Ba ya iya tsayawa na dogon lokaci. Saboda haka ya kira jikansa Hayatuddeen, matashi mai shekara 26 wanda ya yi karatun addini a Kano da Madina.

Kakan ya ce masa, "Jikana, Juma'a mai zuwa kai ne za ka yi huɗuba. Masallata sun san ka tun kana yaro. Ina so su ji muryarka."

Hayatuddeen ya ji tsoro. Ya ce, "Kaka, ban taɓa yin huɗuba a gaban mutane dubu ba. Me zan faɗa musu?"

Malam Sharifai ya yi murmushi. "Ka yi magana a kan abin da kowa yake buƙata. Ka tunatar da su cewa sallah farilla ce a kan kowane Musulmi, kuma ka roƙi Allah ya ba matasa shiriya. Kada ka yi dogon jawabi. Abin da ke da muhimmanci, ka nanata shi sau biyu ko uku, domin masallata su riƙe shi."

Duk mako Hayatuddeen yana shirya huɗubarsa. Kowace safiya yakan karanta juzu'i guda na Alƙur'ani, sannan ya rubuta abin da zai faɗa. Da yamma yakan karanta wa kakansa. Kakan yakan ce, "Wannan wuri ka nanata shi."

Ranar Alhamis wani matashi ya zo gidan, ya tambayi Hayatuddeen, "Malam, a mazhabarmu, wane hukunci ne ga wanda ya bar sallah? Kuma mutane suna ta yaɗa wata fatawa daga wata ƙasa a waya. Shin mu bi ta?"

Daga baya kakansa ya ce wa Hayatuddeen, "Ka kiyaye. Fatawa ba wasa ba ce. Ba kowace fatawa da aka gani a waya ce ta dace da mazhabarmu ba. Idan ba ka da tabbas, ka ce ba ka sani ba, ka tambayi manyan malamai."

Ranar Juma'a aka yi kiran sallah daga saman hasumiyar masallacin, kuma masallata suka cika masallacin har waje. Hayatuddeen ya tashi, hannunsa yana rawa. Sannan ya ce, "Ya ku jama'a, sallah farilla ce. Ba abu ne da mutum zai yi idan ya ga dama kawai ba. Na sake nanatawa: sallah farilla ce a kan kowannenmu."

Ya yi magana a kan matasa da ke kwana suna kallon waya har su manta da sallar asuba. Ya ce, "Mu roƙi Allah ya ba mu da 'ya'yanmu shiriya." A ƙarshe ya ce, "Allah ya karɓi ibadarmu, amin summa amin." Masallata suka amsa da murya ɗaya, "Amin summa amin!"

Malam Sharifai ya kalli hasumiyar masallacin, wadda mahaifinsa ya gina. Ya ce wa jikansa, "Mahaifina ya gina wannan hasumiya. Ni na yi huɗuba a ƙarƙashinta shekara arba'in. Yanzu kai za ka ci gaba. Allah ya ba ka shiriya, amin summa amin."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Malam Sharifai ba ya iya yin huɗuba?
Domin ya tsufa, kuma ƙafafunsa ba su da ƙarfi; ba ya iya tsayawa na dogon lokaci.
Me kakan ya ce Hayatuddeen ya nanata?
Ya ce ya nanata abin da ke da muhimmanci, wato sallah farilla ce.
Me Hayatuddeen yake karantawa kowace safiya?
Yakan karanta juzu'i guda na Alƙur'ani.
Me kakan ya ce game da fatawa daga waya?
Ya ce ba kowace fatawa da aka gani a waya ce ta dace da mazhabarsu ba.
Yaya masallata suka amsa addu'ar Hayatuddeen?
Suka amsa da murya ɗaya, "Amin summa amin!"

lessons.title: Walimar Hafsatu
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the grandmother Hajiya Jummala weaves cloth on her old loom for her granddaughter Hafsatu's wedding; a tailor makes it into a dress and a matching hijab, the grandmother gives her a pearl necklace from her own wedding, laughs at her grandson Mukhtari's necktie, and the guests at the wedding feast admire the dress over bowls of food and fruit.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Jummala tana zaune a Zaria. Tun tana 'yar shekara goma sha biyu take saƙa. Har yanzu, tana da shekara saba'in da biyar, takan zauna a ƙofar gidanta tana saƙa.

Watan nan za a yi auren jikarta Hafsatu. Kwana uku kafin ɗaurin auren, za a yi walima a gidansu. Hafsatu ta ce, "Kaka, zan sayi yadi mai kyau a kasuwa domin rigar walima."

Kakar ta girgiza kai. "A'a, jikata. Ni zan saƙa miki zane da hannuna. Duk jikokina mata, na saƙa wa kowace zanen aurenta."

Hafsatu ba ta ji daɗi ba. Tana ganin zanen saƙa tsohon abu ne, na tsofaffi. Amma ta ce, "To, Kaka."

Hajiya Jummala ta yi kwana ashirin tana saƙa. Ta zaɓi zare fari da shuɗi, ta haɗa su da zare mai launin zinariya. Da ta gama, ta ba Hafsatu zanen, ta ce, "Ki kai shi wurin tela."

Hafsatu ta kai zanen wurin wani tela a kasuwa. Da telan ya buɗe shi, ya yi mamaki. Ya ce, "Kai! Wannan saƙa ce ta gaske. Yanzu ba a samun irin wannan. Zan ɗinka miki riga, kuma da sauran zanen zan yi miki hijabi wanda ya dace da ita."

Bayan mako ɗaya telan ya gama. Hafsatu ta sa rigar da hijabin a gaban madubi, ta ga sun yi kyau fiye da yadda ta zata.

Ranar walima, kakarta ta kira ta cikin ɗakinta. Ta buɗe wani ƙaramin akwati, ta fito da sarƙar lu'ulu'u. "Mahaifiyata ta ba ni wannan sarƙar lu'ulu'u ranar aurena, shekara sittin da suka wuce. Yau na ba ki ita." Hafsatu ta rungume kakarta, hawaye suna zuba daga idanunta.

Ƙanen Hafsatu, Mukhtari, ya shigo ɗakin sanye da kwat da taye ja. Kakar ta yi dariya. "Mukhtari, me ya sa ka ɗaure wannan taye a wuyanka? A zamaninmu ba a sa taye a walima." Mukhtari ya ce, "Kaka, yanzu duk samari suna sa taye." Kakar ta ce, "To, tun da taye abu ne na zamaninku, ka sa shi."

A walimar, an jera kwanukan abinci: kwanun tuwo, kwanun shinkafa da miya, da kwanun nama. A gefe guda kuma akwai kayan marmari: ayaba, lemu da mangwaro. Yara suka yi ta cin kayan marmari har suka ƙoshi.

Rigar Hafsatu ta ƙayatar da baƙi sosai. Kowace mace da ta zo sai ta tambayi, "Ina aka samo wannan zane?" Hafsatu takan nuna kakarta, ta ce, "Kakata ce ta saƙa shi." Wata ƙawarta ta ce, "Wannan riga ta ƙayatar da ni fiye da duk rigunan bana."

Da dare ya yi, Hafsatu ta zauna kusa da kakarta. Ta ce, "Kaka, don Allah ki koya mini saƙa." Hajiya Jummala ta yi murmushi.

Tambayoyi:
Tun yaushe Hajiya Jummala take saƙa?
Tun tana 'yar shekara goma sha biyu take saƙa.
Me telan ya yi da zanen?
Ya ɗinka wa Hafsatu riga, kuma da sauran zanen ya yi mata hijabi.
Me kakar ta ba Hafsatu ranar walima?
Ta ba ta sarƙar lu'ulu'u da mahaifiyarta ta ba ta ranar aurenta.
Me ya sa kakar ta yi dariya ga Mukhtari?
Domin ya ɗaure taye, kuma a zamaninsu ba a sa taye a walima.
Me Hafsatu ta roƙi kakarta a ƙarshe?
Ta roƙe ta ta koya mata saƙa.

lessons.title: Kakan maharbi
lessons.summary: In a village near Bauchi, wild pigs are eating the farm of Maharazu, an old hunter; at dawn he takes his grandson Ilyas to find them, reading their tracks in the dew and the damp earth, showing him a chameleon and teaching him patience; in the heat Ilyas suffers from thirst, and when a pig bursts out of the grass the boy screams in panic, but his grandfather leaps up and drives the pigs away with the dogs.
lessons.text:
Malam Maharazu yana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Bauchi. A lokacin ƙuruciyarsa shi ne babban maharbi a yankin. Yanzu yana da shekara saba'in, kuma ya daina farauta. Amma a wannan damina wasu aleɗe suna shiga gonarsa kowane dare, suna cinye masararsa da dankalinsa.

Jikansa Ilyas, mai shekara goma sha biyar, ya zo hutu daga birni. Da ya ji labarin aleɗen, ya ce, "Kaka, ka bar ni in tafi tare da kai mu kori aleɗen nan."

Kakan ya ce, "Ba ka taɓa shiga daji ba. Maharbi yana buƙatar haƙuri. Amma to, za mu tafi da asuba."

Da asuba suka fita, tare da karnuka biyu. Akwai raɓa a kan ciyawa, kuma ƙafafun Ilyas sun yi sanyi. Kakan ya tsaya a gefen gonar, ya nuna ƙasa. "Duba. Danshin ƙasa yana nuna mana sawun aleɗe. Ka ga sawun nan sababbi ne, domin raɓa ba ta rufe su ba tukuna. Aleɗen sun wuce nan kafin hasken rana."

Suka bi sawun a hankali. Danshin ƙasa ya sa sawun ya bayyana sosai. A kan wani reshe Ilyas ya ga wata hawainiya. Launinta kore ne kamar ganye. Da ta koma kan reshe mai ruwan ƙasa, sai launinta ya canja.

Kakan ya ce, "Ka ga hawainiya? Tana tafiya a hankali, ba ta gaggawa. Kowane maharbi yakan koyi haƙuri daga wurin hawainiya. Kada ka yi gaggawa, kada ka yi surutu."

Suka yi tafiya har rana ta yi zafi. Ilyas ya fara jin ƙishirwa. Ya manta da ruwansa a gida. Ƙishirwa ta dame shi har bakinsa ya bushe. Kakansa ya ba shi gorarsa, ya ce, "Maharbi ba ya barin ruwa a gida. Ƙishirwa ta fi yunwa wahala a daji."

Can sai karnukan suka tsaya. A cikin doguwar ciyawa, Ilyas ya ga wani abu yana motsi: wata ƙaramar wutsiya ce. Kakan ya ce, "Wutsiyar aleɗe ce. Ka tsaya a bayana."

Nan da nan wani babban aleɗe ya fito daga ciyawar da gudu, ya taho wajensu. Firgici ya kama Ilyas. Ya yi wata babbar kururuwa, ya faɗi a ƙasa. Kakansa kuwa ya zabura, ya yi tsalle ya tsaya gaban jikansa, ya riƙe sandarsa sama, ya yi wata kururuwa mai ƙarfi. Karnukan suka bi aleɗen da haushi. Aleɗen ya juya, wutsiyarsa a sama, ya gudu cikin daji.

Ilyas ya tashi. Ya ce, "Kaka, ka ga yadda na yi kururuwa? Na ji kunya."

Kakan ya ce, "Kada ka ji kunya. Ko maharbi mafi ƙarfin hali yakan ji firgici a farkon farautarsa. Ni ma na yi kururuwa ranar farko."

Washegari kakan da jikansa suka gina shinge a kewayen gonar. Aleɗen ba su sake dawowa ba.

Tambayoyi:
Me aleɗe suke yi a gonar Malam Maharazu?
Suna shiga kowane dare, suna cinye masararsa da dankalinsa.
Yaya kakan ya san aleɗen sun wuce da asuba?
Danshin ƙasa ya nuna sawunsu, kuma raɓa ba ta rufe sawun ba tukuna.
Me maharbi yake koya daga hawainiya?
Yakan koyi haƙuri, domin hawainiya tana tafiya a hankali, ba ta gaggawa.
Me ya sa Ilyas ya ji ƙishirwa sosai?
Domin ya manta da ruwansa a gida, kuma rana ta yi zafi.
Me kakan ya yi da aleɗen ya fito?
Ya zabura, ya tsaya gaban jikansa, ya yi kururuwa.

lessons.title: Fasfon Hajiya Mero
lessons.summary: In Kano, Hajiya Mero wants to visit her daughter Zulaiha, who has just had a baby in London, but she has never had a passport; her grandson Lukmanu fills in the online form on his phone, she counts every naira in her old notebook, the immigration office hurries her passport for the naming ceremony, and a travel agent gives her a discount on the ticket.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Mero tana da shekara sittin da takwas. Tana zaune a Kano tare da jikanta Lukmanu, wanda yake karatu a jami'a. 'Yarta Zulaiha tana zaune a Landan tare da mijinta. Wata rana Zulaiha ta kira ta a waya, ta ce, "Mama, na haihu! Na haifi 'ya mace. Za a yi suna nan da wata ɗaya. Don Allah ki zo."

Hajiya Mero ta yi murna, amma sai ta tuna: ba ta taɓa samun fasfo ba. Ta kira Lukmanu, ta ce, "Jikana, ya za a yi in sami fasfo?"

Lukmanu ya ce, "Kaka, yanzu ana cike fom a waya." Ya fito da wayarsa ta salula, ya buɗe shafin hukumar fasfo. Kakar ta ce, "A ina fom ɗin yake? Ban ga takarda ba." Lukmanu ya yi dariya. "Fom ɗin yana cikin salula, Kaka. Ba sai an yi takarda ba."

Ya tambaye ta sunanta, ranar haihuwarta da garinta, ya cike fom ɗin. Sai ya ce, "Kuɗin fasfo dubu talatin da biyar ne."

Hajiya Mero ta tashi, ta buɗe kabad ɗinta, ta fito da wani tsohon daftari. A cikin wannan daftari take rubuta duk kuɗin da ta samu da wanda ta kashe tun shekara ashirin. Ta zauna, ta ƙididdige kuɗinta a hankali da yatsunta. Lukmanu ya ce, "Kaka, akwai na'urar ƙididdige a cikin salula." Ta ce, "Ni da kaina nake ƙididdige kuɗina. Daftarina bai taɓa yin kuskure ba."

Ta buɗe walet ɗinta, ta fitar da kuɗin. Ta ba Lukmanu, ya sa a walet ɗinsa, sai ya biya ta salularsa. Ta rubuta komai a daftarinta.

Washegari suka je ofishin hukumar shige da fice. Aka ɗauki hotonta da yatsunta. Jami'in ya ce, "Fasfon zai fito nan da mako shida." Hajiya Mero ta ce, "Ɗana, nan da wata ɗaya za a yi sunan jikata a Landan." Lukmanu ya nuna masa saƙon Zulaiha. Jami'in ya ce, "To, zan roƙi shugabana ya hanzarta aikin." Aka hanzarta, kuma bayan kwana goma fasfon ya fito.

Sai tikitin jirgi. Lukmanu ya duba a salula, ya ga tikiti yana da tsada. Suka je wani kamfanin tafiye tafiye. Mai kamfanin ya ce, "Ga tsofaffi masu shekara sittin zuwa sama muna yin ragi na kashi goma." Hajiya Mero ta ce, "Ragi kaɗai ba zai ishe ni ba. Ka ƙara mini." Mai kamfanin ya yi dariya, ya ƙara ragi na kashi biyar. Ta ƙididdige kuɗin a daftarinta, ta ce, "To, yanzu ya yi."

Da suka dawo, ta sa fasfonta da tikitinta a cikin kabad, ta kulle shi.

A Landan, Zulaiha ta sa jaririyar a hannun mahaifiyarta. Hajiya Mero ta kira Lukmanu ta salula, ta ce, "Jikana, na gode. Ba don kai ba, da ban ga jikata ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Hajiya Mero take son zuwa Landan?
Domin 'yarta Zulaiha ta haihu a can, kuma za a yi suna.
A ina Lukmanu ya cike fom ɗin fasfo?
Ya cike shi a cikin wayarsa ta salula.
Me Hajiya Mero take rubutawa a daftarinta?
Duk kuɗin da ta samu da wanda ta kashe.
Me jami'in ya yi domin fasfon ya fito da wuri?
Ya roƙi shugabansa ya hanzarta aikin.
Wane ragi kamfanin ya yi mata?
Da farko ya yi ragi na kashi goma, sannan ya ƙara kashi biyar.

lessons.title: Ruwa ya malala
lessons.summary: Near the Tiga dam in Kano State, the old farmer Malam Ummaru and his granddaughter Sumaiya hear that water is pouring over the dam after heavy rain; the councillor warns the village, young men pile up sandbags, the flood traps a family who climb onto a water tank, and the state government provides tents and food to ease the people's hardship.
lessons.text:
Malam Ummaru yana da shekara saba'in da biyu. Yana da gonar shinkafa mai kadada uku a bakin kogi, ba nisa daga madatsar ruwa ta Tiga a jihar Kano. Jikarsa Sumaiya, mai shekara ashirin da ɗaya, tana karatu a jami'a, kuma ta zo hutu a gidansa.

A wannan shekara ruwan sama ya yi yawa ƙwarai. Kwana biyar ana ruwa ba tsayawa. Wata rana da yamma, Sumaiya tana duba wayarta, sai ta ga wani labari. Ta ce, "Kaka! Ruwa ya cika madatsar Tiga, har ya fara malala ta saman katangarta."

Malam Ummaru ya ce, "Ni ba na yarda da labaran waya. A shekara ta 1988 an yi irin wannan ruwa. Amma sai rediyo ya faɗa nake yarda."

Ba a daɗe ba sai kansila na mazaɓarsu, Malam Shuaibu, ya zo ƙauyen a cikin mota yana magana da lasifika. "Jama'a, ku saurara! Ruwa yana malala daga madatsar ruwa. Kogi zai cika. Ku bar gidajen da ke bakin kogi!"

Matasan ƙauyen suka taru. Kansilan ya kawo buhuna, suka cika su da yashi, suka jibge su a bakin kogin domin ruwan kada ya shiga gari. Sumaiya ma ta taimaka. Har dare suna jibge buhunan yashi. Gwamnati kuma ta jibge jami'an tsaro da masu ceto a yankin.

Da tsakar dare ruwan ya iso. Ya malala a kan gonaki, ya rufe gonar Malam Ummaru duka, kadada uku na shinkafa. Ruwan ya rutsa da wani iyali a gida na ƙarshe a bakin kogi: uba, uwa da yara uku. Ba su iya fita ba. Suka hau kan tankin ruwa mai tsawo da ke bayan gidansu.

Sumaiya ta kira masu ceto a waya, ta faɗa musu inda iyalin suke. Ta ce, "Ruwa ya rutsa da su, suna zaune a kan tankin ruwa." Masu ceton suka zo da ƙaramin jirgin ruwa, suka sauko da su daga kan tankin ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Babu wanda ya mutu.

Washegari ruwan ya fara janyewa. Gwamnatin jiha ta tanadar da tantuna a makarantar firamare ga waɗanda gidajensu suka rushe. Ta kuma tanadar da abinci, magunguna da barguna. Kansila Shuaibu ya ce, "Mun tanadar da wannan ne domin mu sassauta wahalar da jama'a suke ciki."

Malam Ummaru ya tsaya a bakin gonarsa, ya duba shinkafarsa da ta lalace. Sumaiya ta ce, "Kaka, gwamnati ta ce za ta ba manoma iri da taki domin a sassauta asarar da suka yi."

Kakan ya yi shiru na ɗan lokaci, sai ya ce, "A shekara ta 1988 ba mu da waya. Ba mu ji labari ba sai da ruwa ya shiga ɗakunanmu. Yau ku matasa kun ji labari da wuri, kun ceci rayuka. Na yarda, jikata, wayarku ma tana da amfani."

Tambayoyi:
Gonar Malam Ummaru tana da girman nawa?
Tana da kadada uku.
Ina Sumaiya ta fara ganin labarin ruwan?
Ta gan shi a wayarta.
Me matasan suka yi a bakin kogi?
Suka cika buhuna da yashi, suka jibge su a bakin kogin.
Ina iyalin da ruwa ya rutsa da su suka hau?
Suka hau kan tankin ruwa da ke bayan gidansu.
Me gwamnati ta tanadar domin ta sassauta wahalar jama'a?
Ta tanadar da tantuna, abinci, magunguna da barguna.

lessons.title: Kirarin kaka
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the schoolboy Jibrilu, his grandfather's namesake, must write an English essay on his family's history; he thinks his grandfather's praise epithets are just boasting and that classmates call the old man an ignoramus, but the grandfather explains how the epithets link the family to its forebears, refuses to sing them for a politician, and Jibrilu's essay wins praise.
lessons.text:
Jibrilu yaro ne mai shekara goma sha huɗu a Sokoto. Sunansa sunan kakansa ne, saboda haka shi takwaran kakansa ne. Kowa a gida yakan kira kakan "Babban Jibrilu," shi kuma yaron "Takwara."

Wata rana malaminsu na Turanci ya ba su aiki: kowane ɗalibi ya rubuta labarin tarihin iyalinsa a Turance. Jibrilu ya damu. Ya ce wa kansa, "Me zan rubuta a Turance game da iyalinmu? Babu wani abu na musamman."

Kakansa ya ji damuwarsa. Shi tsohon maroƙi ne wanda ya yi shekara hamsin yana yi wa sarakuna kirari. Ya ce, "Takwara, zauna in yi maka kirarin kakanninmu." Sai ya fara da murya mai ƙarfi, yana ambaton sunayen kakanni bakwai, da ayyukansu, da garuruwan da suka zauna.

Jibrilu ya yi dariya. "Kaka, wannan kirari taƙama ce kawai. Ana yabon mutum har a wuce gona da iri."

Kakan ya ɗaga gira. "Anya kuwa? Ka tabbata taƙama ce?"

"Haka abokaina suke cewa," in ji Jibrilu. "Wasu ma suna cewa kai jahili ne, domin ba ka iya karatun Turance ba."

Kakan bai yi fushi ba. Ya ce, "Ban iya Turance ba, gaskiya ne. Amma ni ba jahili ba ne. Jahili shi ne wanda bai san asalinsa ba. Kirari ba taƙama ba ne. Kirari yana alaƙanta mutum da kakanninsa tun fil azal. Duk wanda ya ji kirarinmu zai san inda muka fito, abin da kakanninmu suka yi, da halayensu. Kirari tarihi ne da ake rerawa."

Jibrilu ya yi shiru. Kalamin kakansa ya shiga zuciyarsa. Ya ce, "Kaka, ka sake mini kirarin a hankali, zan rubuta shi."

A daren nan wani ɗan siyasa ya zo gidan. Yana neman kujera a majalisar jiha, kuma ya ce wa kakan, "Baba, ina so ka riƙa yi mini kirari a tarurrukan kamfe. Zan biya ka kuɗi masu yawa."

Kakan ya girgiza kai. "Ɗana, kirarin da nake yi gaskiya ne, yana alaƙanta mutum da asalinsa. Idan na yi maka kirari siyasance, zan faɗi abin da ba gaskiya ba domin a zaɓe ka. Ba zan yi ba." Ɗan siyasar ya tafi ba tare da wani kalami ba.

Jibrilu ya ga duk abin da ya faru. Ya ce, "Kaka, ashe kai mai gaskiya ne. Anya akwai wanda zai ƙi kuɗi haka a garinmu?"

Bayan mako biyu, Jibrilu ya rubuta labarinsa a Turance. Ya rubuta kirarin kakanninsa, ya fassara kowane layi, ya bayyana yadda kirari yake alaƙanta su da tarihinsu tun fil azal. Malaminsa ya karanta labarin a gaban aji, ya ce, "Wannan ne labari mafi kyau a ajin bana."

Da Jibrilu ya dawo gida, ya ce wa kakansa, "Babban Jibrilu, ka koya mini kirari. Ba na so ya ɓace."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa ake kiran Jibrilu "Takwara"?
Domin sunansa sunan kakansa ne; shi takwaran kakansa ne.
Wane aiki malaminsu ya ba su?
Kowane ɗalibi ya rubuta labarin tarihin iyalinsa a Turance.
Me abokan Jibrilu suke cewa game da kakansa?
Suna cewa shi jahili ne domin bai iya karatun Turance ba.
Me kakan ya ce kirari yake yi?
Ya ce kirari yana alaƙanta mutum da kakanninsa tun fil azal.
Me ya sa kakan ya ƙi yi wa ɗan siyasar kirari?
Domin idan ya yi masa kirari siyasance, zai faɗi abin da ba gaskiya ba.

lessons.title: Zamba ta waya
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, the retired civil servant Alhaji Mudassiru gets a call from a man who says he is from his bank; he gives a code, the fraudsters break into his account and take a huge sum, and his granddaughter Hasana calls the bank's genuine number; the bank denies calling him, the police find the gang that works in secret, and the old man, who once kept his money in a strongbox, learns to spot fake messages.
lessons.text:
Alhaji Mudassiru ya yi ritaya daga aikin gwamnati a Kaduna shekara goma da suka wuce. Yanzu yana da shekara saba'in da huɗu. Yana da asusu a banki, inda yake ajiye kuɗin fanshonsa da duk abin da ya tara a rayuwarsa.

Wata safiya wayarsa ta yi ƙara. Wani mutum ya ce, "Barka da safiya, Alhaji. Ni ma'aikacin bankinka ne. An rufe asusunka saboda wata matsala. Za mu turo maka lamba a waya. Ka faɗa mini lambar domin mu buɗe asusun."

Alhaji Mudassiru ya damu. Lambar ta zo, ya karanta wa mutumin. Mutumin ya ce, "Na gode, Alhaji. An gama," sai ya kashe wayar.

Bayan minti goma sai saƙonni suka fara shigowa wayarsa: an cire kuɗi, an sake cirewa, an sake cirewa. Ya kira jikarsa Hasana, wadda take karatun kimiyyar kwamfuta. Da ta zo ta duba wayar, ta ce, "Kaka, wannan zamba ce! Wannan mutumin ba ma'aikacin banki ba ne. Su 'yan zamba ne. Sun kutsa cikin asusunka da lambar da ka ba su."

Ta duba saƙonnin, ta ga cewa sun cire zunzurutun kuɗi har naira miliyan uku. Kakan ya ce, "Zunzurutun kuɗi haka! Kuɗin da na tara shekara talatin!"

Hasana ta ce, "Kada ka kira lambar da mutumin ya yi amfani da ita. Bari mu kira bankin ta tabbataccen layinsa, wanda ke rubuce a bayan katinka." Ta kira tabbataccen layin bankin. Ma'aikaciyar bankin ta ce, "Bankinmu ba ya kira mutane ya nemi lambar sirri. Mun ƙaryata wannan kiran. Ba mu kira ka ba." Ta rufe asusun domin kada 'yan zamban su sake kutsa ciki.

Suka je ofishin 'yan sanda. Wani jami'i ya ce, "Waɗannan 'yan zamba suna aiki a asirce. Sukan yi komai a asirce, a wurare daban daban. Amma za mu bi su." Bayan wata ɗaya, 'yan sanda suka kama wani matashi a Kano wanda ake zargi. Ya ƙaryata komai a gaban 'yan sanda, ya ce bai san Alhaji Mudassiru ba. Amma an sami waya da katunan banki da yawa a gidansa, kuma bayan bincike banki ya dawo wa Alhaji da naira miliyan biyu.

Wata rana Alhaji Mudassiru ya ce wa jikarsa, "A zamaninmu, mahaifina yakan ajiye kuɗinsa a cikin taska a ɗakinsa. Babu wanda ya taɓa kutsa cikin taskarsa."

Hasana ta yi dariya. "Kaka, amma ɓarayi suna iya sace taska gaba ɗaya!"

Daga nan Hasana ta koya wa kakanta yadda zai gane saƙon bogi da kiran bogi. "Idan aka turo maka saƙo mai cewa ka ci kyauta, bogi ne. Idan wani ya nemi lambarka ta sirri, bogi ne. Ka kira tabbataccen layin banki kawai."

Alhaji Mudassiru ya koyi darasi. A masallaci, ya tara abokansa tsofaffi, ya ce, "Ku saurara, zan koya muku yadda ake gane zamba ta waya."

Tambayoyi:
Me mutumin da ya kira Alhaji Mudassiru ya ce?
Ya ce shi ma'aikacin bankinsa ne, kuma an rufe asusunsa.
Yaya 'yan zamban suka kutsa cikin asusunsa?
Sun yi amfani da lambar da ya karanta musu.
Nawa 'yan zamban suka cire?
Sun cire zunzurutun kuɗi har naira miliyan uku.
Me ma'aikaciyar bankin ta ce game da kiran?
Ta ƙaryata kiran, ta ce bankinsu bai kira shi ba.
Ina mahaifin Alhaji Mudassiru yake ajiye kuɗinsa?
Yakan ajiye kuɗinsa a cikin taska a ɗakinsa.

lessons.title: Iddar Hajiya Hauwau
lessons.summary: In Gombe, Hajiya Hauwau is in her iddah after her husband's death; her grandchildren Rashidu and Hamdatu visit, she seats them on her mat and makes the ginger tea she and her husband used to drink on the charcoal stove, explains why religion makes the waiting period obligatory, tells them how she carried their father on her back, and turns down Rashidu's offer to move her to Abuja because this is her permanent home.
lessons.text:
Wata ɗaya da ya wuce, Alhaji Halliru, mijin Hajiya Hauwau, ya rasu a Gombe. Sun yi aure shekara hamsin da biyu. Yanzu Hajiya Hauwau tana cikin idda. Ba ta fita daga gida, ba ta sa kayan ado, kuma ba ta sa turare.

Jikokinta biyu, Rashidu daga Abuja da ƙanwarsa Hamdatu, suka zo su gaishe ta. Da suka shigo, kakar ta tashi, ta rungume su. Ta zaunar da su a kan kujeru kusa da ita. Ta ce, "Ku zauna, ku zauna. Bari in yi muku shayi."

Ta kunna wutar gawayi a cikin murhunta. Hamdatu ta ce, "Kaka, me ya sa ba ki amfani da gas? Gawayi yana da wahala." Kakar ta ce, "Da gawayi na saba tun ina yarinya. Shayin gawayi ya fi daɗi."

Ta fito da citta daga kwando, ta wanke ta, ta daka ta, ta sa ta a cikin ruwan zafi. Ƙamshin citta ya cika ɗakin. Ta ce, "Ni da kakanku mukan sha shayin citta kowace safiya bayan sallar asuba. Mukan zauna a nan, mukan yi hira har rana ta fito. Yanzu ni kaɗai ce nake sha."

Rashidu ya tambaye ta, "Kaka, har yaushe za ki yi a cikin idda?"

"Wata huɗu da kwana goma," in ji ta. "Addini ya wajabta wa duk matar da mijinta ya rasu ta yi idda. Allah ne ya wajabta mana ita. A lokacin idda, mace takan zauna a gidan mijinta, tana yi masa addu'a."

Hamdatu ta duba wani tsohon hoto a bango. A cikin hoton akwai wata budurwa da jariri a bayanta. "Kaka, ke ce wannan?"

Kakar ta yi murmushi. "Ni ce. Wannan jaririn mahaifinku ne. Na goya shi a bayana ina zuwa gona. Na goya duk 'ya'yana bakwai haka. A lokacin babu mota, sai ƙafa."

Rashidu ya ce, "Kaka, bayan iddarki, ina so ki zo Abuja ki zauna tare da mu. Ba na so ki zauna ke kaɗai."

Kakar ta girgiza kai. "Na gode, jikana. Amma wannan ne zaunannen gidana. A nan na yi aure, a nan na haifi 'ya'yana, a nan kakanku yake kwance. Zan zo Abuja in ziyarce ku, amma ba zan bar gidana ba. Gida zaunanne shi ne gidan da zuciyarka take."

Bayan shayi, kakar ta yi addu'a. "Allah ya jiƙan kakanku, da duk matattunmu, da matattun Musulmi baki ɗaya." Rashidu da Hamdatu suka ce, "Amin."

Ta sake zaunar da su, ta ba su kofi na biyu. Kafin su tafi, Hamdatu ta ce, "Kaka, bayan iddarki zan zo mu sha shayin citta tare." Kakar ta yi dariya. "To. Sai ki zo da wuri, kafin gawayin ya mutu."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Hajiya Hauwau take cikin idda?
Domin mijinta Alhaji Halliru ya rasu wata ɗaya da ya wuce.
Da me kakar take dafa shayi?
Takan dafa shi da wutar gawayi.
Me kakar da mijinta suke yi kowace safiya?
Sukan sha shayin citta bayan sallar asuba, su yi hira.
Wa ya wajabta wa mata idda?
Allah ne ya wajabta musu idda a addini.
Me ya sa kakar ba za ta koma Abuja ba?
Domin gidanta shi ne zaunannen gidanta, inda ta yi aure ta haifi 'ya'yanta.

lessons.title: Jikan da ake jira
lessons.summary: In Jos, Saddiku and Maimunatu have been married five years without a child, and his mother Hajiya Furaira harasses the young wife and turns her back on her; a doctor tests them both and finds a small, treatable problem in Saddiku's semen; Saddiku tells his mother the truth, she apologises, and a year later a tiny baby is born perfectly well.
lessons.text:
Saddiku da Maimunatu sun yi aure shekara biyar a Jos, amma ba su sami haihuwa ba. Mahaifiyar Saddiku, Hajiya Furaira, tana zaune a gidansu. Kullum tana yi wa Maimunatu tsangwama. Takan ce, "Shekara biyar ba ki haihu ba. Ɗana yana buƙatar ɗa." Wani lokaci takan ce wa Saddiku ya auri wata mace.

Maimunatu tana haƙuri da tsangwamar. Kowace yamma takan ɓare wa surukarta lemu, ta kawo mata a cikin faranti. Amma Hajiya Furaira ba ta gode mata. Takan juya mata keya, ta ci gaba da kallon talabijin. Wata rana Maimunatu ta ɓare lemu biyar, ta ajiye su a gabanta, amma surukar ta juya mata keya, ba ta ce komai ba. Maimunatu ta shiga ɗakinta ta yi kuka.

Saddiku ya ji kukanta. Ya ce, "Kada ki damu. Gobe za mu je asibiti tare da zummar mu san gaskiyar lamarin."

Washegari suka je wurin wani likita, Dakta Amadu, da zummar a gwada su. Likitan ya ce, "Idan ma'aurata ba su sami haihuwa ba, ba a ɗora laifin a kan mace kaɗai. Dole ne a gwada ku duka biyu." Ya auna nauyinsu a kan sikeli, ya ɗauki jininsu. Ya ce wa Saddiku, "Kai kuma za mu gwada maniyyinka a ɗakin gwaji."

Bayan mako ɗaya suka koma. Dakta Amadu ya ce, "Maimunatu ba ta da wata matsala. Matsalar tana cikin maniyyin Saddiku. Amma matsala ce ƙanƙanuwa, ba babba ba. Da magani na wata uku, da abinci mai kyau, za ta iya warkewa." Ya kuma ce, "Ka rage nauyinka kaɗan. Sikeli ya nuna cewa nauyinka ya yi yawa."

A hanyarsu ta zuwa gida, Saddiku ya ce, "Zan faɗa wa Mama gaskiya. Ba zan bar ta ta ci gaba da tsangwamarki ba."

Da suka isa gida, Saddiku ya zauna kusa da mahaifiyarsa, ya ce, "Mama, mun je asibiti. Likita ya ce matsalar tana cikin maniyyina, ba a jikin Maimunatu ba. Duk tsangwamar da kika yi mata, ba laifinta ba ne."

Hajiya Furaira ta yi shiru. Sai ta juya ga Maimunatu, ta ce, "'Yata, ki yafe mini. Na zalunce ki." Maimunatu ta ce, "Mama, na yafe miki." A wannan yamma, a karon farko, Hajiya Furaira ta ce, "Na gode," da Maimunatu ta ɓare mata lemu.

Saddiku ya sha maganinsa, yana takawa kowace safiya. Bayan wata huɗu, Maimunatu ta sami ciki.

Shekara guda bayan ziyararsu ta farko a asibiti, Maimunatu ta haifi ɗa namiji. Jaririn ƙanƙane ne, amma lafiyarsa ƙalau. Ma'aikaciyar asibiti ta sa shi a kan sikeli: kilo uku. Ta ce, "Jaririn lafiya ƙalau, mahaifiyarsa ma lafiya ƙalau."

Hajiya Furaira ta ɗauki jaririn ƙanƙane a hannunta, hawaye suna zuba daga idanunta. Ta ce, "Allah ya raya shi. Yau na zama kaka."

Tambayoyi:
Wane irin hali Hajiya Furaira take yi wa Maimunatu?
Tana yi mata tsangwama, takan juya mata keya.
Me Maimunatu take yi wa surukarta kowace yamma?
Takan ɓare mata lemu ta kawo mata a cikin faranti.
Me Dakta Amadu ya gwada?
Ya auna nauyinsu a kan sikeli, ya ɗauki jininsu, ya gwada maniyyin Saddiku.
A ina matsalar take?
Matsalar tana cikin maniyyin Saddiku, kuma ƙanƙanuwa ce.
Yaya jaririn yake da aka haife shi?
Jaririn ƙanƙane ne, amma lafiyarsa ƙalau.

lessons.title: Bulalar Malam Sulaimanu
lessons.summary: In Maradi, the retired teacher Malam Sulaimanu, who once caned pupils, visits his old school after a fight breaks out at the students' gathering place; he hears from the student Zakiru why the pupils defied a teacher who beat them, admits that the cane of his day was oppression, and offers to coach the debating team so the school can win back the title it last held under him.
lessons.text:
Malam Sulaimanu ya yi shekara talatin yana koyarwa a wata babbar makarantar sakandare a Maradi, a Jamhuriyar Nijar. A lokacinsa, duk malami yana da bulala. Idan ɗalibi ya yi laifi, ko ya makara, sai a yi masa bulala. Yanzu Malam Sulaimanu ya yi ritaya, yana da shekara saba'in da ɗaya.

Wata rana shugabar makarantar ta kira shi. Ta ce, "Malam, an yi hargitsi a makaranta jiya. Ɗalibai sun yi faɗa, an karya kujeru. Muna so ka zo ka yi musu magana. Suna girmama tsofaffin malamai."

Malam Sulaimanu ya je makarantar. A ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya a tsakiyar makarantar, ɗalibai da yawa sun taru. Wannan wuri shi ne matattararsu tun zamaninsa. A wannan matattara ce aka fara hargitsin jiya.

Wani ɗalibi mai suna Zakiru ya zo ya gaishe shi. Malam Sulaimanu ya tambaye shi, "Me ya jawo hargitsin nan?"

Zakiru ya ce, "Malam, wani sabon malami ya zo da bulala. Ya yi wa wani ɗalibi bulala goma saboda ya manta da littafinsa. Yaron ya ji ciwo. Sai mu ɗalibai muka bijire, muka ƙi shiga ajinsa. Wasu suka goyi bayan malamin, sai faɗa ya ɓarke."

Malam Sulaimanu ya ce, "Kun bijire wa malami. Wannan ba daidai ba ne. Amma ku kuma kun yi faɗa a tsakaninku, kun karya kayan makaranta. Hargitsi ba ya magance komai."

Sai ya tara ɗaliban a matattararsu, ya ce, "Ku saurare ni. Ni ma a zamanina ina da bulala. Na yi wa ɗalibai da dama bulala a wannan makaranta. A lokacin muna ganin cewa haka ake koyarwa. Amma yanzu na fahimci cewa wannan danniya ce. Ɗalibin da ake yi wa danniya ba ya koyo, sai tsoro yake koyo. Na yi nadama."

Ɗaliban suka yi mamaki.

Malam Sulaimanu ya ci gaba, "Kun san cewa a shekara ta 1994 wannan makaranta ta ci kambin gasar muhawara ta ƙasar Nijar baki ɗaya? Ni ne na horar da ɗaliban. Ba mu yi amfani da bulala ba, sai littattafai da aiki tuƙuru. Tun daga lokacin makarantar ba ta sake cin wannan kambi ba."

Zakiru ya ce, "Malam, mu ma muna son mu ci kambin nan."

Malam Sulaimanu ya ce, "To, ku daina bijire wa malamanku, ku daina hargitsi. Ni kuma zan zo nan sau biyu a mako, in horar da ku. Ina so in amfanar da ku da abin da na koya a shekara talatin. Idan na amfanar da ku, na amfanar da ƙasarmu ma."

Shugabar makarantar ta yi murna.

Bayan wata takwas, ɗaliban makarantar suka tafi Niamey don gasar muhawara. Zakiru ne ya yi magana ta ƙarshe. Suka ci kambin. Da suka dawo, suka kawo kambin a matattararsu a ƙarƙashin bishiya, suka ba Malam Sulaimanu ya riƙe.

Tambayoyi:
Ina ne matattarar ɗaliban?
Matattararsu tana ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya a tsakiyar makarantar.
Me ya sa ɗaliban suka bijire wa sabon malamin?
Domin ya yi wa wani ɗalibi bulala goma saboda ya manta da littafinsa.
Me Malam Sulaimanu ya ce game da bulalar da yake yi a zamaninsa?
Ya ce danniya ce, kuma ya yi nadama.
Me Malam Sulaimanu yake so ya yi wa ɗaliban?
Yana so ya amfanar da su da abin da ya koya, ya horar da su su ci kambi.
